name: Reverse fly
summary: Hinged forward, raise light dumbbells out to the sides with soft elbows, squeezing the shoulder blades.
setup: Hinge forward until the trunk is near level, dumbbells hanging under the shoulders, soft elbows. Raise the arms out to the sides, squeezing the blades together, then lower slowly.
why: Hinged over, the arms sweep toward and away from a front phone and the trunk hides them from the side. Logged by hand.
tempo: Up 2 s, squeeze 1 s, down 2 s.
regression: Lighter; chest supported on an incline bench.
contraindications: Lower back pain in the hinge.

faults.label: Standing up as the arms lift
faults.tip: The trunk holds still; if it rises, the weight is too heavy.

faults.label: Bending the elbows
faults.tip: Bending the elbows turns it into a row and takes the rear shoulder out.

faults.label: Shrugging
faults.tip: Lead with the elbows out, not up.

faults.label: Lifting above shoulder line
faults.tip: Past shoulder height the trapezius takes the load.

points.t: Sweep out to the sides; blades squeeze.
